title: Reversi Game Sample built via my custom CLI/MCP
author: _playlogic_
selftext:
Not to long ago I posted an CLI/MCP I have been working on in parallel with a puzzle dice game. As I get closer to release of the big 1.0, I have been doing my best to find time to create good samples to show it off. Reversi is the first of many of the sample I have planned.

As a side note: I get there are many, many MCP's tools out there, opinions on the need vs. the Godot cli, and even those that have been let down in the past by other such tools.  All I ask is try it,  
read the docs, see if it works for you. No need to have the same comment over and over about it

  
[https://regiellis.github.io/godot-reversi/](https://regiellis.github.io/godot-reversi/)
